title.zh: 春日京都：与樱花的约定
title.en: Spring Kyoto: A Date with Sakura

excerpt.zh: 四月初的京都，街道两旁的樱花树次第绽放。这是我第二次来到日本，却是第一次真正意义上与樱花相遇——不是照片里的粉色云海，而是站在岚山渡月桥边，任花瓣轻轻落在肩头的那种真实感动。
excerpt.en: In early April, Kyoto's streets burst into pink as cherry trees bloom in unison. My second trip to Japan, but my first true encounter with sakura — not the pink clouds in photos, but petals drifting onto my shoulders at Arashiyama's Togetsukyo Bridge.

title.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚：被遗忘的亚得里亚海明珠

excerpt.zh: 在欧洲旅行者的地图上，阿尔巴尼亚常常是一片空白。但正是这种
的气质，让这里的亚得里亚海海岸、古老城堡和热情好客的当地人，带给我意想不到的惊喜。
excerpt.en: On most travelers' maps of Europe, Albania is a blank spot. But it's precisely this 'undiscovered' quality that makes its Adriatic coastline, ancient fortresses, and extraordinarily warm people such a revelation.
